# Saveiy

> Saveiy is India's smart subscription manager and bill tracker. Know what's renewing, spot hidden fees, and cancel forgotten subscriptions across UPI AutoPay, cards, OTT and SaaS.

Saveiy detects every recurring charge from UPI mandates, card auto-debits and billing emails, sends renewal alerts before you're billed, and surfaces cheaper Indian alternatives. Built by Corewave Innovations, incubated at SCIE Pune and recognised under iStart Rajasthan.
